pages.name: Italian Game: Evans Gambit, Stone-Ware Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed the b1-knight to c3 (the c3-pawn stands there); plan 2 played ...d6 with the bishop on d6. Rewrote both plans and the overview (the d6-bishop blocks the d-pawn and the c8-bishop); British spelling.

pages.name: Evans Gambit: Tartakower Attack, 7...Qd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted a knight via d2-f1-g3 with no f1 route open after castling; the overview called the Tartakower Attack (7.Qb3) Black's defence. Rewrote the overview and plans 1, 2 and 4.

pages.name: Evans Gambit: Tartakower Attack, 8.dxe5 Bb6
pages.notes: Plan 2 recaptured on e5 with a b6-bishop that can't reach it; rewritten around ...Na5 against the c4-bishop and b3-queen. British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Evans Gambit: Tartakower Attack, 8.dxe5 dxe5
pages.notes: Plan 3 developed the knight to c3 (a pawn stands there); now Nbd2. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Italian Game, Evans Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d5 with no White d-pawn (Black's pawn is on d4); plan 2 spoke of White's bishop pair (both sides have two bishops). Both rewritten around 8.e5 d5 9.exf6 dxc4, Ba3, Qb3 and Rb1.

pages.name: Italian Game: Evans Gambit, Compromised Defense, Potter Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 sent the knight to 'key squares like d5' (read as a pawn move); plan 1 had sacrifices on e6 where nothing stands. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Italian Game: Evans Gambit, Lasker Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 named 'weak points (f7, b6)' where b6 holds Black's bishop; rewritten around 8.dxe5 dxe5 9.Qxd8+ Nxd8 10.Nxe5 and the a4 and Qb3 alternatives. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Italian Game: Evans Gambit, Mieses Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4-d5 with no White d-pawn; the overview called 5...Ba5 the Mieses (it is 7...Nge7). Rewrote the overview and plan 1 (8.cxd4, Ng5, d5); British spelling in plans 2 to 4.

pages.name: Italian Game: Evans Gambit, Tartakower Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed the knight to c3 (a pawn stands there); now Nbd2 and dxe5. British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3's Nbd2-f1-g3 was impossible with the d2-pawn unmoved; now tied to the 5.d3 lines. 'IQP' spelled out; British spelling throughout.
